Vendored from npm for the live demo on the portfolio page.

- `auro-formkit-demo.js`: esbuild bundle of `@aurodesignsystem/auro-formkit@6.2.2` (menu, select, combobox, datepicker, registered), with `lit` included.
- `tokens-*.css`: `@aurodesignsystem/design-tokens@9.4.3` CSS custom properties.

- `icons/interface/*.svg`: the few icons the demo needs, from `@alaskaairux/icons@5.32.0`. The bundle's icon CDN URL is rewritten to point here.
